messages:
jess_support: StrataWorks escalated — on mobile Safari (iPhone 12 / iOS 16) the chart legend hover/tap highlights the wrong series. Tooltip content doesn't match the highlighted line. Customer says it started after last deploy. Screenshot: https://redwood.screenshots/strata-legend-mismatch.png :rotating_light:

kai_mobile_ui: Repro'd on simulator. Happens in compact dashboard when there are >6 series and horizontal scroll appears. Tap a legend entry -> different series flashes. Not consistent but frequent. :eyes:

matt_frontend: I think this lines up with the virtualization change from PR 632 (we started reusing DOM nodes for legend rows). Could be stale index -> key mismatch. No backend API changes.

jess_support: Customer provided console log too: `Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read property 'dataset' of undefined` and HAR. They need either a hotfix or a clear workaround.

omar_backend: Confirming nothing on API side — metrics/ids unchanged. This is purely client-side rendering/state mapping.

jess_support: Repro steps the customer sent: 
1) Mobile Safari iPhone 12, portrait, compact dashboard
2) Open chart with 7+ series
3) Tap legend entries on the right to toggle/highlight
4) Observe highlighted line != tooltip content (values belong to a different series)

kai_mobile_ui: Quick inspection shows legend rows are virtualized and we use array index for `key`/mapping. When the slice changes, indices shift but the hover handler still references old index -> wrong series. Patch idea: use stable `series.id` for keys and bind handlers to id instead of index.

matt_frontend: I'll open a small PR to force stable keys and update the handler. Proposed change in component `CompactLegend.tsx`:

```js
// BEFORE
<li key={i} onMouseEnter={() => onHover(i)}>...
// AFTER
<li key={series.id} onMouseEnter={() => onHover(series.id)}>...
```

matt_frontend: Adding an e2e mobile Safari test for the hover/tap mapping as well. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/849 (draft)

jess_support: ETA for a fix? Customer is P1 for UX — wants either hotfix or a rollback of PR 632.

oncall_ops: Rolling back PR 632 would touch other releases. Hotfix deploy possible if PR is small and passes smoke. We can schedule a hotfix window in ~2 hours if eng is ready.

matt_frontend: I'll prioritize a small fix and make it hotfix-ready. If we can't get tests green in time, fallback is rollback.

kai_mobile_ui: Quick patch branch `fix/mobile-legend-key` is up on staging: https://staging.redwood-inference/compact-legend-fix (QA only). Can anyone validate on a real iPhone? I couldn't attach screenshot from simulator reliably.

jess_support: Sent the staging link to StrataWorks support contact (they can test). Workaround in meantime: open the dashboard in desktop mode or disable compact legend in dashboard settings — they said that avoids the bug. Also clearing Safari cache reduces reproductions.

support_bot: Note created: SUP-4982 — "legend hover maps to wrong series on mobile compact dashboard". Assigned to matt_frontend / kai_mobile_ui.

kai_mobile_ui: Update: small unit + e2e tests added. If QA on staging looks good I'll request hotfix deploy. 

matt_frontend: TY. If support gets more customers reporting this, escalate and we'll roll back.

jess_support: Keeping thread open. Please ping this thread when PR is ready for hotfix. :thumbsup:
